description: Filter the plant catalog by botanical attributes. Returns lean records ({productId, botanicalName, commonName, height, spread, kind} — mature height and spread in metres, the top of each range). Filter by `kind` (grass, perennial, shrub…) instead of guessing names: the catalog is small, and a name you know may not be in it. Call get_plant_attributes first to discover valid filter values for the current locale. Multi-value filters use OR semantics (any value matches); different filters are AND-combined. Range filters use overlap semantics (a plant's range must intersect the requested range). Capped at limit (default 25, max 100); response includes total + truncated flag. Use get_plant_info only to check a finalist's requirements. Falls back to a loud error if the index is unavailable on the CDN — agents should retry name-based queries via search_products in that case.

bloomPeriod.description: OR-match against the plant's bloomPeriod array. Roman months I–XII; use get_plant_attributes.bloomPeriod.

flowerColor.description: OR-match against the plant's flowerColor array. Use values from get_plant_attributes.flowerColor.

foliageType.description: Exact match against the plant's foliageType. Use a value from get_plant_attributes.foliageType.

hardiness.description: Overlap match against the plant's USDA hardiness zone range.

height.description: Overlap match: the plant's height range must intersect [min, max] (inclusive), metres.

max.description: Upper bound in meters (omit for no upper bound)

min.description: Lower bound in meters (omit for no lower bound)

kind.description: Catalog kinds; any of them matches (e.g. ["grass"], ["perennial", "herb"]). Fruit = fruiting perennials such as strawberries; fruit bushes are shrubs.

limit.description: Max matches returned (default 25, clamped to [1, 100]). The total count of all matches is always returned, so you can detect truncation.

maintenanceLevel.description: OR-match against the plant's maintenanceLevel. Use values from get_plant_attributes.maintenanceLevel.

query.description: Optional substring match (case-insensitive) on botanicalName OR commonName. No diacritic stripping — pass terms as they appear in the locale (e.g. 'Jeżówka', not 'jezowka'). Exact matches are ranked first.

soil.description: OR-match against the plant's soil array. Use values from get_plant_attributes.soil.

spread.description: Overlap match in METERS, same semantics as height.

sunlight.description: OR-match against the plant's sunlight array. Use values from get_plant_attributes.sunlight.

name: search_plants
